messages:
alex: Heads-up — hotfix PR #7890 needs dual signoff before the 12:00 PT cutoff today. CI flaked on integration once earlier; tagging @maya @tim for fast reviews and approvals.

deploy-bot: CI: integration-tests flaky on `linux-2` (job 4521). Re-run queued.

maya: On it. I'll watch the re-run and do a quick pass. If tests stay stable I can approve. ETA ~10m.

tim: I can give the second review. Noticed one tiny docstring nit but that's non-blocking. If CI is green I'll drop an LGTM.

alex: @maya re-run finished and passed. Quick callout — this is a kv-cache eviction edge fix, no DB or schema changes, so no migration note required.

luca: Suggest we squash the incidental fixup commit before merging so history stays clean. @tim okay to LGTM post-squash?

tim: Yep squash is fine. Ping me after squash+rebase and I'll stamp.

maya: :thumbsup: Squashed and force-pushed `fix/kv-evict-hotfix` -> `origin/`. CI re-triggered.

deploy-bot: Merge bot: required approvals = 2/2, CI = all checks passed. Merge queued.

alex: Great — merging into the 12:00 PT window. If anything trips in prod we'll trigger the rollback playbook; otherwise I'll follow up with the release note snippet. Thanks everyone!
